Dynamic Programming and Optimal Substructure
Dynamic programming solves complex problems by breaking them down into overlapping
subproblems and storing intermediate solutions in a memoization table or 2D array.
Optimal substructure ensures the global optimum can be constructed from local subproblems.

Dijkstra Shortest Path Algorithm
Finds the shortest paths between nodes in a graph with non-negative edge weights.
Uses a priority queue min-heap to achieve O(|E| + |V| log |V|) asymptotic time complexity.
